programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: It is 1914. As the Great War looms, the mighty Ottoman Empire is crumbling. Constantinople, the once vibrant, multicultural capital on the shores of the Bosporus, is about to be consumed by chaos.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: "Match Point" is a drama about ambition, the seduction of wealth, love, and sexual passion. Perhaps most importantly, however, the story reveals the huge part luck plays in events, refuting the comforting misconception that more of life is under our control than really is.

programme.title: The Book of Love
programme.desc: When Penny, the light of Henry's life, is killed in a car crash, he puts everything on hold as he tries to come to terms with his loss. When his bereavement leave is over, everyone expects straight-laced Henry to return to work. But now everything has changed and Henry is not going back.

programme.title: The Duke
programme.desc: When the faithful canine companion to the Duke of Dingwall, Hubert, inherits the Duke's estate, he teams up with the Butler's niece to fend off some greedy family members.

programme.title: City Lights
programme.desc: With the aid of a wealthy tippler, a dewy-eyed tramp who has fallen in love with a sightless flower girl accumulates money to be able to help her medically.

programme.title: Calling for Love
programme.desc: Successful podcast host Samantha Desouza has a passion for music and an aversion to romance after a recent bad experience. Just when her show is thriving, she is thrown in the deep end by her boss and re-assigned to host Heartwaves, a feel-good love songs show with a segment that reunites lost loves. Despite her initial lack of enthusiasm, her first caller is the charismatic and charming Jake who has a problem she's determined to help solve. What they didn't expect was to fall for each other in the process. Now Sam must decide whether to shy away from love again, or to be a little more spontaneous and follow her heart…

programme.title: The Quest: The Longest Drive
programme.desc: To help out an old friend and save his ranch, the Beaudine brothers gather a bunch of oddballs to help drive a big herd to market. Dive into the exciting adventure with a stable worker, a retired gunslinger, a washed-up drunk, and two crafty rustlers as they take on the dusty trail.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury "consultant" will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Old-school salesmen Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) try to reboot their careers by joining Google's fiercely competitive internship program — with hilarious results!

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace becomes a princess when a summer trip to Paris turns into the fantasy of a lifetime.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: The legendary Cimmerian warrior, Conan, fights an epic battle against hulking rivals, horrific monsters, and impossible odds, as he realizes he is the only one who can save the great nations of Hyboria from an encroaching reign of supernatural evil.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: A mortal teams with the god Horus in an alliance against Set, the god of darkness, who usurped Egypt's throne.

programme.title: Dune
programme.desc: A Duke's son leads his warriors against an evil baron and tries to destroy a galaxy-wide 'spice' trade.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: A man from another world crash lands on Earth during the age of the Vikings.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle (2014)
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in the sleepy town of Rockford when Sheriff Rick Langston (Dean Cain, Lois & Clarke: The New Adventures of Superman) arrests a mysterious man who resembles Santa Claus. However, when the townspeople's Christmas wishes all start to come true, the sheriff begins to wonder if this jolly old man just might be the real deal. It is when he is out of love and luck and at his most cynical that the sheriff meets Lucy (Christine Lakin, Valentine\s Day) and is shown the miracle of love and family. As Christmas Day fast approaches, new relationships are forged and existing ties are strengthened in this uplifting festival story for the whole family.

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior decorator and Christmas fanatic, Leslie Major, has the yearly task of decorating the lobby of the famed Chesterton Hotel. But one fateful day whilst working on a ladder to reach the top of the tree, she falls into the arms of Edmund James, the grandson of the hotel's owner. However, Edmund is all business and plans to put an end to the annual tradition. Can Leslie work her magic and teach him to love Christmas?

programme.title: A Miracle on Christmas Lake
programme.desc: After the loss of his best friend on Christmas Eve, Bobby goes out onto the lake and makes a shocking discovery. When the land is bought, Bobby must rally the town to save it.

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

programme.title: Christmas With a Crown
programme.desc: When a successful woman returns to her hometown to revive her family's Christmas festival, she meets a dashing stranger who's volunteered to help organise the event. Sparks begin to fly between them, but little does she know that he's really a prince in disguise, longing to find the true spirit of the holidays! It will take a Christmas miracle of royal proportions for their hearts to meet as one.

programme.title: Come Away
programme.desc: The film follows the adventures of siblings Alice and Peter who transform into Peter Pan and Alice in Wonderland in a bid to help their parents - played by Oyelowo and Jolie - overcome the tragedy of losing their eldest son. Peter and Alice find strength in the power of their imaginations and set off on a real adventure to try and rescue the family - escaping to a destiny of eternal boyhood in the distant isle of Neverland - whilst Alice delves into a world of Wonderland.

programme.title: The Bombing
programme.desc: Inspired by the heroic, untold true story of Chongqing. Starring legends Bruce Willis (Die Hard) and Adrien Brody (The Pianist), this pulse-pounding war epic centres around the courage of Chinas citizens during WWII. As U.S. Air Force commander Jack Johnson trains the Chinese aviators to battle Japanese fighters, a hot-headed pilot begs to fly a powerful bomber that could stop the attacks.

programme.title: Valhalla: Legend of Thor
programme.desc: No man, woman or child may defy the gods. When Thor and Loki seek refuge in the home of mortals, the youngest son fails to heed a warning from the gods. As atonement for the family's sins, the gods take the two youngest children under their wing and embark on an epic adventure from Midgard to Valhalla that will see them stare down ruthless giants, barbaric gods and the dreaded wolf Fenrir.

programme.title: Wolves of War
programme.desc: A fast-paced, action-packed war thriller based on true events. Decorated British officer Jack Wallace (Ed Westwick - Gossip Girl) must lead a band of Allied commandos across enemy lines to rescue an American scientist held hostage by the Nazis. With information that could turn the tide of war, these unlikely heroes must traverse enemy territory with an untrained US civilian to secure victory.

programme.title: Loving Vincent
programme.desc: Vincent Willem van Gogh is undoubtedly one of the most famous and influential figures in the history of Western art. Yet during his lifetime Vincent struggled with poverty and depression, dying at only 37 years old.

programme.title: Love and Honor
programme.desc: While fighting in Vietnam, Dalton hears his girlfriend back home has dumped him. He has a week's leave coming up so decides to fly to get her back. AWOL from the war zone, he has seven days to get back to the US, change his girlfriend's mind and make it back to Vietnam without anyone noticing.

programme.title: Five Nights in Maine
programme.desc: A man, reeling from the tragic loss of his wife, travels to rural Maine to seek answers from his estranged mother-in-law, who is herself confronting grief. With David Oyelowo and Dianne Wiest.

programme.title: Bee Season

programme.title: My Sweet Holiday

programme.title: Christmas Romance Al Dente

programme.title: A Gingerbread Romance

programme.desc: (2017) Festive romance with Lacey Chabert. Kylie reconnects with her ex-boyfriend ahead of taking part in the American Gingerbread Competition. Will they be able to cook up love?

programme.desc: A young woman has a chance to save the love of her life when she discovers that the mix-tape they made together can transport her back in time.

programme.title: Holiday in The Hamptons
programme.desc: A woman inherits her grandfather's home in the Hamptons and reconnects with her childhood love.

programme.title: A Christmas Village
programme.desc: To save her reputation, Piper Jensen, a public relations genius and owner of her own PR company, agrees to work for the owner of a failing Santa's Village and discovers love and how magical Christmas is after all.

programme.title: Love Wedding Marriage
programme.desc: A happy newlywed marriage counselor's views on wedded bliss get thrown for a loop when she finds out her parents are getting divorced. Starring: Mandy Moore, Kellan Lutz, James Brolin

programme.title: Wuthering Heights (1970)
programme.desc: A passionate adaptation of Emily Brontë's superbly strange and hauntingly enduring classic novel, starring Timothy Dalton and Anna Calder-Marshall as the doomed and deathless lovers, Heathcliff and Cathy. Directed by Robert Fuest.

programme.desc: Megan seems to have the perfect life with a wonderful husband named Thomas and 2 adorable children. Then she finds herself awakening from a coma – and discovers she is not and has never been married. But when she meets Thomas for real, she seizes the chance to help him fall in love with her, again—for the first time.

programme.title: Plus One at an Amish Wedding
programme.desc: April Monroe is a superstar doctor at a big New York hospital, who has fallen head-over-heels for charming veterinarian Jesse, and their relationship seems to be heading in the right direction except for one thing: Jesse is completely tight-lipped about his Amish family.

programme.title: Belle and the Beast
programme.desc: Eric Landry is a cold-hearted man that people have nicknamed "the Beast." Years of anger and bitterness have consumed him, turning him into a selfish man. But Belle Watson is the exact opposite. When her father accidentally breaks a valuable work of art at the Landry mansion, Belles agrees to work for Eric in an effort to repay him and save her father's job. She discovers there just might be more to Eric. Will she find the man within the Beast?

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: When her truck breaks down in the mid-west, Sara is invited to park her camper on a family ranch while her truck is repaired. She meets two brothers, who are as different as night and day. The brothers are instantly smitten with Sara and soon she begins to have feelings for them both. The last thing Sara expected to find was romance on the ranch.

programme.title: Off The Menu
programme.desc: An unlikely heir to a Mexican fast-food franchise goes ‘cuisine' hunting for the next culinary big thing he can ‘borrow,' and finds himself in a small, dusty New Mexican town where people come from all over to salivate over the culinary treats of a local female chef.

programme.title: Jim Henson's Turkey Hollow.
programme.desc: Lifetime Original Movie traces the Emmerson family's journey to Turkey Hollow.

programme.title: Last Chance for Christmas.
programme.desc: Santa's handsome but beleaguered stable master John must rush off to Alaska.

programme.title: Kirk Franklin's The Night Before Christmas.
programme.desc: Journee and Nia are caught in a snowstorm and they take refuge inside a church.

programme.title: Snowed Inn Christmas.
programme.desc: Jenna Hudson and Kevin Jenner are polar opposites.

programme.title: Last Chance for Christmas.
programme.desc: Santa's handsome but beleaguered stable master John must rush off to Alaska.

When problems begin to rise during the creative process, Kate and Josh decide to relive their past forcing them to fall in love all over again.

programme.title: Do I Say I Do

programme.title: Til Ex Do Us Part
programme.desc: As Kyle and Sophia reconnect, she's accused of assaulting his friend Claire, a woman he slept with once.

Maggie cannot handle what follows and recruits a friend to help her plan to get out of town with her step father's secrets. When Peg discovers that her daughter has run away, she now has to find Maggie fast but must come to terms with the dark secrets that led to Maggie's fleeing and the secrets about her new husband.

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) meets the girl of his dreams (Brooklyn Decker) but has to enlist his loyal assistant Katherine (Jennifer Aniston) to pretend to be his soon-to-be ex-wife in order to cover up a careless lie. When more lies backfire, Katherine's kids become involved, and everyone heads off to Hawaii for a ridiculous, out-of-control weekend that tests the limits of how far we'll go for love.

programme.desc: In Columbia Pictures' comedy Paul Blart: Mall Cop, Kevin James stars as the title character, a single, suburban dad, trying to make ends meet as a security officer at a New Jersey mall. Though no one else takes his job seriously, Paul considers himself on the front lines of safety. When a heist shuts down the megaplex, Jersey's most formidable mall cop will have to become a real cop to save the day.

programme.title: Paul Blart
programme.desc: After six years of keeping our malls safe, Paul Blart (Kevin James) has earned a vacation. He heads to Vegas with his teenage daughter and finds that safety never takes a holiday. When duty calls, Blart answers.

programme.title: Major League II
programme.desc: The Indians are now a World Series contender. But last year's hunger is now replaced with complacency, and bad decisions by the new owner threaten to tear the team apart.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: A woman struggling with insecurity wakes from a fall believing she is the most beautiful woman on the planet. Her new confidence empowers her to live fearlessly, but what happens when she realizes her appearance never changed?

programme.title: Black Knight

programme.title: The Spy Next Door

programme.title: Hero Mode

programme.title: Something Big
programme.desc: A man kidnaps the wife of a cavalry commander in order to exchange her for a Gatling gun that's being sold by a gun runner.

programme.title: Border Shootout
programme.desc: Young rancher Kirby Frye is appointed deputy in a small town tyrannized by ruthless Phil Sundeen, the son of one of the founders of the town.

programme.title: Massacre
programme.desc: A gang of gunrunners is pursued by Mexican Rurales and Yaqui Indians. The police want to stop the tribes from attacking farmers, while the Yaqui seek revenge for bad medicine that blinded their children. Both groups capture the criminals but find themselves trapped by angry tribes at a ruined mission. Can cops and criminals unite to survive?

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The sole surviving Texas Ranger (Klinton Spilsbury) of an ambush arranged by outlaw leader Major Bartholomew "Butch" Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd) returns to fight back as a great masked western hero, The Lone Ranger.

programme.title: All the Names of God
programme.desc: The gripping story of an unsuspecting taxi driver who becomes a pawn in a dangerous game of survival as he is taken hostage after a terrorist attack.

programme.desc: Two penniless friends decide to rob a store--but end up instead in a police office where they are drafted as new recruits. Starring Terence Hill and Bud Spencer.

programme.title: Memories of Montmartre
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Paris, France to find a stolen locket, so they can clear Sydney's dead grandmother of the charges.

programme.title: The Put Back
programme.desc: Kuba, Africa 100 AD: Worshippers of Woote curse his idol to protect it. 2000: Ross Crawford comes to Sydney, because he took the idol and the curse has accelerated his aging.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lost
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel set out to find if the legend of the lost civilization in New Guinea is actually true. Unfortunately, they have to team up with Derek Lloyd.

programme.title: Dagger of Death
programme.desc: India, 500 A.D.: A precious dagger is used in human sacrifices to goddess Kali. Sydney must return a relic to India for her fellow hunter, who believes the dagger made him kill his assistant.

programme.title: Last of the Mochicas
programme.desc: On a search for a South American Mochica Indian relic of protection, Nigel and his colleagues get captured by local guerrillas. It's up to Sydney and ally Jason Clark to save them.

programme.title: Fertile Ground
programme.desc: Sydney reunites with her high school sweetheart to track down a Hawaiian fertility idol in Madagascar.

programme.title: Gypsy Jigsaw
programme.desc: Sydney receives a deck of rare Tarot cards from her recently deceased friend. The infamous, previously unmentioned Vulture was after him. Sydney enlists Claudia to help.

programme.title: Kill 'Em All
programme.desc: When a mysterious stranger arrives at a local hospital on the brink of death, an FBI interrogation unlocks an international plot of revenge.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter

An MIT math whiz is recruited by a teacher to join a specialized team of card counters. They break away from their mentor before casino security finally catches up with them. Based on book "Bringing Down the House." It co-stars Lawrence Fishburne (Matrix Trilogy).

programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Labyrinth

programme.desc: During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor. The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, "The Best Is Yet To Come," "Fly Me to the Moon," and his signature song "I Left My Heart in San Francisco."

programme.title: Herbie Hancock
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: McCoy Tyner, Avery Sharpe & Louis Hayes
programme.sub-title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner's first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson's and Art Farmer's Jazztet. He's also known for his work with the John Coltrane Quartet. Tyner's style is easily comparable to Coltrane's maximalist style of saxophone. Though a member of Coltrane's group, he was never overshadowed by the saxophonist, but complemented and even inspired Coltrane's open-minded approach. McCoy Tyner is considered one of the most influential jazz pianists of the 20th century, an honour he earned both with Coltrane and in his years of performing following Coltrane's death.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Eduard Topchjan & Armenian Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer's unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. Berlioz used one melody in each movement of the work representing the artist's beloved, an ‘idée fixe' (a fixed idea or obsession). The work is scored for a large orchestra and features an astonishing array of instrumental colors, including church bells, an off-stage oboe, and strings playing col legno (using the wood of their bow). This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Russian National Orchestra & Mikhail Pletnev
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music. On the program are Suite for Orchestra after the opera 'The Legend of the Invisible City of Kitezh and the Maiden Fevroniya', and Musical Pictures for Orchestra from the opera 'The Tale of Tsar Saltan'. Part of the latter is the famous 'Flight of the Bumblebee'. This concert was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall of the Russian Philharmonic Society in 2017.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Glenn Gould
programme.desc: Television plays a crucial role in popularizing classical music. Not only has it preserved precious moments of music making, but it also helps shape the future of music. The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television. The film dives into television's archives to demonstrate what the medium has done for the dissemination of music. It features rare footage of Arturo Toscanini conducting the NBC Symphony Orchestra in one of the first televised concerts, and captivating fragments from Leonard Bernstein's Young People Concerts. Moreover, the film contains excerpts of great performances from the past, including those by Glenn Gould, Herbert von Karajan, Igor Stravinsky, and Pierre Boulez.

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz
programme.desc: Lenny Kravitz has been consolidated as one of the stars that has been in force for a long time, this has led him to appear all over the world and be part of the most popular festivals in the world. Este año, se topa con su querido Jason Humphrey de la infancia, quien le explica que su abuela también está desesperada por emparejarlo.

programme.title: Consejera matrimonial
programme.desc: Ryan Turner es un bróker de Wall Street, mujeriego y engreído, que cree tener información privilegiada sobre una importante operación financiera. Pero la compra sale mal y en un día pierde su trabajo, sus clientes y todas sus pertenencias.

programme.title: Jappeloup. De padre a hijo
programme.desc: A principios de los 80, dejando una prometedora carrera como abogado, Pierre Durand decide dedicarse en cuerpo y alma a su pasión: el salto de obstáculos. Apoyado por su padre, lo apuesta todo por un joven caballo en que nadie tiene gran fe: Jappeloup. Demasiado pequeño, extraño, imprevisible, lleno de defectos aunque también con extraordinarias aptitudes. Juntos empiezan un camino de sacrificio, superación y trabajo que les convierte en leyenda olímpica.

programme.title: Miss América
programme.desc: Carnelle Scott es una huérfana acogida por sus gentiles parientes que idolatra a su prima mayor, Elain Rutledge, una exganadora del concurso "Miss Firecracker" que se celebra en el pueblo durante el 4 de julio. Decidida a seguir los pasos de Elain, Carnelle solicita la ayuda de la costurera local Popeye Jackson para prepararse para el concurso.

programme.title: Juntos, nada más
programme.desc: Camille limpia oficinas por las noches y dibuja en sus horas libres. Philibert es un joven aristócrata amante de la historia, t…

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Martín Circo Martín, acaba de convertirse en el ganador del mayor premio de la historia de la televisión.

programme.title: El Partido Repartido
programme.desc: Bryan, un ambicioso joven político, conoce a Serena, una poderosa mujer dentro del partido político.

programme.title: Los Dalton Contra Lucky Luke
programme.desc: Con el objetivo de robar un banco, dos ladrones roban un sombrero mágico que les hará invencibles.

programme.title: Doc West
programme.desc: Cuando Minnesota West salva al joven Silver, el chico lo lleva a Holysand, una ciudad al borde del caos.

programme.title: Un romance con Fígaro
programme.desc: Una brillante y joven administradora de fondos, decide dejar atrás su trabajo y su novio de muchos años, para perseguir su sueño de convertirse en cantante de ópera.

programme.title: Adivina quién
programme.desc: Cuando Theresa trae a su prometido, Simon Green, a casa para el 25.º aniversario de boda de sus padres, se olvida de mencionar un pequeño detalle: es blanco. Decidido a romper el compromiso de su hija, Percy Jones demuestra que el padre no siempre sabe lo que hace.

programme.title: Uncle Drew
programme.desc: Un joven propietario de un equipo y Uncle Drew (Kyrie Irving, estrella de la NBA) reúnen al antiguo equipo de baloncesto de Drew para demostrar que un grupo de septuagenarios todavía puede triunfar.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos idénticos (interpretados por Edward Norton) dan un giro cuando el primero, un profesor de filosofía, es confundido por el segundo, un traficante de drogas al que varios clanes del narcotráfico quieren ver muerto.

programme.title: La Chica De Mis Sueños
programme.desc: Una comedia romántica adolescente sobre la búsqueda de la pareja ideal, solo para descubrir que la realidad no está a la altura de la fantasía. Protagonizada por Shane West y James Franco.

programme.title: Uno Más De La Familia
programme.desc: Basada en el best-seller A Dog´s Way Purpose, la novela que narra las aventuras de Bella, una perrita que se embarca en una épica aventura de regreso a casa recorriendo un largo camino después de que la separen de su amo.

programme.title: The Animal (2001)
programme.desc: Puede que no parezca mucho, pero lo que cuenta está dentro. El genio de la comedia Rob Schneider (Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo, Big Daddy), Colleen Haskell del concurso de televisión Survivor, John C. McGinley (Any Given Sunday, The Rock) y Edward Asner (The Bachelor, JFK) aparecen en la comedia más escandalosa e histérica del año. Cuando el guardia de seguridad Marvin Mange (Schneider) responde a una llamada de emergencia sobre un robo en progreso, su sueño de convertirse en policía podría convertirse en realidad. Pero un extraño accidente de tráfico en su camino al lugar del crimen deja a Martin y a su sueño destrozados. Cuando Marvin se despierta una semana después, descubre que un científico desquiciado secretamente ha usado órganos de animales para reconstruir su cuerpo. Con nuevas energías gracias a sus nuevas y mejoradas partes, Marvin consigue fama al instante como superpolicía hasta que su instinto animal empieza a apoderarse de su cuerpo en los peores momentos. Y cuando se enamora de la encantadora y sexy Rianna (Haskell), ¡es magnetismo animal en su máxima expresión en la comedia más divertida y salvaje del año! No te pierdas a Rob Schneider en Big Daddy.

programme.title: Hitch: Especialista en ligues
programme.desc: En esta sofisticada comedia romántica Alex "Hitch" Hitchens (Will Smith) es un legendario (y deliberadamente anónimo) "doctor de citas", que cobra por ayudar a muchos hombres a seducir a las mujeres de sus sueños. Mientras está aconsejando a Albert (Kevin James), un contador sumiso enamorado de la famosa y glamourosa Allegra Cole (la supermodelo Amber Valleta), Hitch encuentra a una rival de su mismo nivel: la fabulosa e ingeniosa Sara Melas (Eva Mendes), una columnista del corazón que sigue todos los movimientos de Allegra. Convertido en un gran soltero profesional, Hitch se enamora extravagantemente de Sara, una reportera cuya mayor primicia podría ser desenmascarar al doctor de citas más famoso de Manhattan.

programme.title: La ley del juez Thorne
programme.desc: El juez Rick Thorne llega a un pueblo dominado por el poderoso Josiah Bannerman y encarcela a su hijo por asesinato. Sin aliados, debe llevarlo a otra ciudad para un juicio justo. Perseguido por los hombres de Bannerman, lucha contra el poder y la corrupción, mientras Amy Lee, sobrina del magnate, debe decidir de qué lado está la verdad.

programme.title: El gran McLintock
programme.desc: El rico ranchero G.W. McLintock utiliza su poder e influencia en el territorio para mantener la paz entre los agricultores, ganaderos, acaparadores de tierras, indios y funcionarios corruptos del gobierno.

programme.title: Los ángeles vengadores
programme.desc: Miles Utley, un guardaespaldas mormón, se ve forzado a cuestionar sus creencias cuando investiga un caso de asesinato y corrupción inmobiliaria. Su búsqueda de la verdad lo empuja a romper con su comunidad y a enfrentarse a oscuros secretos.

programme.title: El niño y el potro
programme.desc: En un pueblo de Galicia vive trabajando la tierra un hombre joven, Andrés, que quedó viudo con la única compañía de su hijo, Andresiño. En la doma de caballos salvajes, Fuco es competidor de Andrés, y quiere ante éste lucir su fuerza para ganarse la admiración de Ana, la joven maestra del pueblo. Tampoco Andrés oculta su admiración por la maestra de Andresiño. Hay otro "personaje" en la historia, Benito, gracioso potrillo del que Andresiño procura no separarse nunca. Fuco se muestra resentido porque Andrés y la maestra han iniciado una relación muy cordial, que se hace cada día más frecuente. Ana tiene, además como alumno más aventajado, a Andresiño.

programme.title: La Hija
programme.desc: Los Amado deciden pasar un fin de semana en la casa de campo de la familia, pero el plan se ve alterado cuando Dominga, la mujer de la limpieza de los Amado, da a luz a un bebé en medio de una reunión familiar.

programme.title: Barrancas
programme.desc: Una película llena de suspenso, emoción y giros inesperados.

programme.title: Tiempo perdido
programme.desc: Un becario argentino que vive en el extranjero regresa a su país para encontrarse con un antiguo profesor de la escuela, su modelo de vida. Pero el encuentro tomará un rumbo inesperado.

programme.title: El Pozo
programme.desc: Pilar no se comunica con los otros, vive en su propio mundo de fantasías, hasta que la familia toma una decisión que cambiará el rumbo de sus vidas. Pilar es autista desde los cuatro años, ahora tiene 26. El padre quiere que la internen pero la madre se niega, esto crea un distanciamiento en la pareja. La familia se está resquebrajando: Alejo, el hijo menor, tiene conflictos en la escuela, y con los amigos Pilar sufre ataques cada vez más frecuentes que tornan imposible la convivencia. Finalmente, la internan. Encontrará otra manera de vivir, pero algo sucederá que cambiará el rumbo de la familia.

programme.title: Las Cosas Como Son
programme.desc: Jerónimo es un antisocial lugareño que alquila habitaciones de su casa a expatriados para poder husmear en sus pertenencias. Un día llega Sanna, una chica que cambiará la vida de Jerónimo. Empiezan a acercarse hasta que Jerónimo descubre que Sanna esconde algo en su casa.

programme.title: Madame
programme.desc: Anne y Bob, una pareja americana que vive en París, organizan una cena e invitan a diez amigos. El hijo de Bob llega por sorpresa y el número total de invitados es ahora de 13. La supersticiosa Anne le pide a su criada, María, que pretenda ser un rico amigo español y se unan a la mesa. María conoce a David, un aristócrata británico. Ambos se gustan y continuarán su relación.

programme.title: El proyecto Colibrí
programme.desc: Dos primos intentan hacerse millonarios mediante la construcción de un cable de fibra óptica entre Kansas y Nueva Jersey, mientras su antigua jefa intenta evitar que lo consigan

programme.title: Una pequeña mentira
programme.desc: Théo es un niño que vive empeñado en levantarle el ánimo a su padre, Laurent, un tipo solitario y completamente desilusionado con la vida. La oportunidad se presenta cuando Theó está a punto de ser admitido en un importante club de fútbol inglés, pero debido a su pequeña estatura es finalmente rechazado. Para no darle una mala noticia a su padre, Théo no se atreve a confesárselo, lo que da pie a una pequeña mentira que muy pronto le vendrá muy grande.

programme.title: Hijos de la medianoche
programme.desc: En la medianoche del 15 de agosto de 1947, el mismo día en que la India consiguió la independencia, Saleem y Shiva nacieron en el mismo hospital de Bombay y formaron parte de la primera generación libre del país. La historia de Saleem y Shiva, intercambiados en sus cunas al nacer, tiene como transfondo la convulsa historia de la India moderna, desde su independencia hasta los años ochenta: poderes sobrenaturales, amores prohibidos y secretos de familia se entremezclan con guerras y golpes de estado.

programme.title: Matria
programme.desc: Ramona vive en un pueblo de Galicia sumida en un contexto laboral y personal tenso e impredecible. Siempre sacrificándolo todo por el futuro de su hija Estrella, se verá empujada a mirar hacia dentro y a pensar que, tal vez, haya algo nuevo por lo que vivir.

programme.title: ¡Ni te me acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo.

programme.title: Benidorm mon amour
programme.desc: Tonet aprovecha un permiso de la mili para ir en coche con sus amigos Sento, Jaume y Tomy a Benidorm. Sueñan con disfrutar unos días del sol, las playas y, sobre todo, de las suecas y sus biquinis.

programme.title: La Mujer sin Piano
programme.desc: Un ama de casa casada para la que no hay nada comparable a la íntima satisfacción de ver el plato humeante servido con admirable puntualidad a la hora de la comida. Veinticuatro horas de su vida de la que una noche decide escapar, y cuenta todo lo que le pasa en esta fuga.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: Chain Letter
programme.desc: Six friends receive a mysterious chain letter via text and email from a maniac who hunts down those who delete the message. Who knew they should take the threats in the chain letter seriously or that their favorite technologies could help track and kill them? This maniacal game pits friend against friend as they try to escape the impossible. Break the chain, lose a life.

programme.title: The Perfect Husband
programme.desc: A married couple decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin, but the romantic journey takes a turn for the worse, when a sneaking suspicion becomes pure madness.

programme.title: Chain Letter
programme.desc: Six friends receive a mysterious chain letter via text and email from a maniac who hunts down those who delete the message. Who knew they should take the threats in the chain letter seriously or that their favorite technologies could help track and kill them? This maniacal game pits friend against friend as they try to escape the impossible. Break the chain, lose a life.

programme.title: 3 Hikers
programme.desc: 'The Three Hikers' tells the story of three Americans (Sarah Shourd, Shane Bauer and Josh Fattal) who went hiking in Northern Iraqi Kurdistan in July 2009, and were captured and held as political hostages by the Iranian Government for more than two years.

programme.title: De Otros Mundos
programme.desc: Una ama de casa deprimida de Brooklyn camina dormida por su vida hasta que es secuestrada por ovnis. Decidida a resolver el misterio de sus experiencias sobrenaturales, se embarca en un viaje que la lleva tanto al romance como a un nuevo sentido de la vida.

programme.title: Los 28 hombres de Panfilov
programme.desc: Rusia, noviembre 1941. Las tropas alemanas se acercan a Moscú. En los alrededores de la ciudad un grupo de 28 soldados del Ejército Rojo de la división 316, bajo el mando del general Ivan Panfilov, trata de detener el avance de la 11 División Panzer, compuesta por 54 tanques y numerosas tropas del ejército nazi.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Musculoso y espectacular reboot de la mítica serie de los 90' a medio camino entre 'Transformers' y el cine de superhéroes. 5 jóvenes estudiantes van a descubrir que La Tierra está al borde de la extinción por una amenaza alienígena. Pronto descubrirán que son los únicos que pueden salvar el planeta

programme.title: Asia connection
programme.desc: Dos expatriados estadounidenses, Jack y Sam deciden robar un banco. Sin saberlo se han llevado el dinero de un poderoso narcotraficante.

programme.title: Altitud
programme.desc: Una agente del FBI es castigada y enviada a un trabajo de administrativa en Washington DC después de desobedecer a sus mandos en una negociación con rehenes. En el avión que le lleva a Washington conoce a un apuesto hombre de negocios que le ofrece una recompensa si le ayuda a bajar del avión.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente I
programme.desc: Joshua McCord es un agente del servicio secreto retirado al que le encargan la misión de entrenar a un joven. Sin embargo, cuando la Primera Dama es secuestrada por terroristas, se encuentra inmerso en una misión de 'todo o nada'.

programme.title: Pentathlon
programme.desc: Un pentatleta de Alemania Oriental deserta en Seúl 1988 y, años después, intenta volver a competir.

programme.title: Contrición
programme.desc: Cuando Tara, una mujer con poderes, desaparece, Axe comienza a buscarla.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Hechos reales: John Travolta es un piloto de lanchas millonario que trabaja con EE. UU. y los cárteles.

programme.title: Elimination Game
programme.desc: Un SEAL acusado injustamente compite contra asesinos para ganar libertad.

programme.title: Los Ángeles de Charlie (2019)
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart, Naomi Scott, y Ella Balinska trabajan para el misterioso Charles Townsend, cuya Agencia de seguridad e investigación se ha expandido internacionalmente. Los nuevos Ángeles son las mujeres más inteligentes, valientes y mejor entrenadas de todo el planeta. Bajo la supervisión de Bosley (Elizabeth Banks), los Ángeles tendrán que proteger una tecnología revolucionaria para evitar que sea convertida en un arma. Además deberán confiar las unas en las otras a medida que sus tareas se vuelven cada vez más peligrosas.

programme.title: Una Relación Peligrosa
programme.desc: El delincuente de poca monta Gigli (Ben Affleck) es famoso por sus grandes meteduras de pata. Ricki (Jennifer Lopez) es una gánster con temperamento. Cuando emprenden juntos una misión que se descontrola a lo grande, ¿acabarán resolviendo sus diferencias personales y poniendo remedio a su atracción mutua? Dirigida por Martin Brest (Scent of a Woman), ¡GIGLI es una comedia romántica de alto voltaje que te hará entrar en calor!

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) sigue un rastro de pistas a través de Europa con Sienna Brooks (Felicity Jones) para detener un virus que acabaría con la mitad de la población mundial.

programme.title: El Último Gran Héroe
programme.desc: El joven Danny Madigan vive obsesionado con Jack Slater, el mayor héroe de las películas de acción de la historia, y a menudo sueña con vivir alguna de sus increíbles aventuras. La última de Jack va a ser estrenada y uno de los acomodadores del cine, conocedor de la admiración que el chico siente por su héroe, le regala una entrada para verla. Un ticket que resulta ser mágico y permite al adolescente cruzar la pantalla y protagonizar la película junto a su admirado.
